subject: This feature works best right now
preview_text: Here's why you need to open SoulPlan before the weekend ends
body_paragraphs: You know that feeling when you realize the weekend is almost here and you still have no clue what to do? Yeah, I just had that panic myself. But then I remembered something I've been sitting on for weeks.

Right now, there are dozens of local pop-ups, seasonal events, and hidden date spots that are only open for a few more days. Most couples will miss them because they don't know they exist. But you don't have to be most couples.

That's exactly why we built the Local Discovery feature inside SoulPlan. It scans what's happening near you right now and matches it with your date preferences. No scrolling through generic lists. It's like having a friend who always knows the coolest thing to do this weekend.

Open the app, tap 'Discover Local' and see what's popping up near you tonight. One tap and you'll have a plan that makes your partner think you're a genius. P.S. The Surprise Date Planner is a game-changer for this weekend. Plan something, keep it secret, and watch their face light up.
